The '''Old Galactic Market Shipping and Receiving Docks''' was an area in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was the site of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|armed insurrection]] against the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].
